+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""
+Migration script to add last_updated column to client_defects table
+"""
+
+from sqlalchemy import text
+from config.database import SessionLocal
+
+def upgrade():
+    """Add last_updated column to client_defects table if it doesn't exist"""
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    
+    try:
+        # Check if last_updated column exists
+        column_check = db.execute(text("""
+            SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
+            WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'client_defects' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'last_updated'
+        """)).fetchone()
+        
+        if not column_check:
+            print("Adding last_updated column to client_defects table...")
+            db.execute(text("ALTER TABLE client_defects ADD last_updated DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()"))
+            db.commit()
+            print("Successfully added last_updated column to client_defects table.")
+        else:
+            print("last_updated column already exists in client_defects table.")
+            
+        print("Migration completed successfully.")
+        
+    except Exception as e:
+        db.rollback()
+        print(f"Error adding last_updated column: {e}")
+        raise
+    finally:
+        db.close()
+
+def downgrade():
+    """Remove last_updated column from client_defects table"""
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    
+    try:
+        print("Removing last_updated column from client_defects table...")
+        
+        # SQL Server doesn't support DROP COLUMN directly in all versions, 
+        # so we use ALTER TABLE
+        db.execute(text("ALTER TABLE client_defects DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS last_updated"))
+        
+        db.commit()
+        print("Successfully removed last_updated column from client_defects table.")
+        
+    except Exception as e:
+        db.rollback()
+        print(f"Error removing last_updated column: {e}")
+        raise
+    finally:
+        db.close()
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    upgrade()

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""
+Migration script to add missing columns to customer_claims table
+"""
+import pyodbc
+import os
+from dotenv import load_dotenv
+
+load_dotenv()
+
+def get_db_connection_string():
+    """Get database connection string from environment variables"""
+    server = os.getenv("DB_SERVER")
+    database = os.getenv("DB_NAME")
+    username = os.getenv("DB_USER")
+    password = os.getenv("DB_PASSWORD")
+    
+    return f"DRIVER={{ODBC Driver 17 for SQL Server}};SERVER={server};DATABASE={database};UID={username};PWD={password}"
+
+def add_missing_columns():
+    """Add missing columns to customer_claims table"""
+    conn_str = get_db_connection_string()
+    
+    try:
+        conn = pyodbc.connect(conn_str)
+        cursor = conn.cursor()
+        
+        # Check and add each column if it doesn't exist
+        columns_to_add = [
+            ("lpn", "NVARCHAR(50) NULL"),
+            ("container_no", "NVARCHAR(50) NULL"),
+            ("action", "NVARCHAR(200) NULL"),
+            ("period", "NVARCHAR(20) NULL"),
+            ("image_paths", "NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL"),
+            ("image_captions", "NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL")
+        ]
+        
+        for col_name, col_type in columns_to_add:
+            # Check if column exists
+            cursor.execute("""
+                SELECT COUNT(*) 
+                FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS 
+                WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'customer_claims' AND COLUMN_NAME = ?
+            """, col_name)
+            
+            if cursor.fetchone()[0] == 0:
+                print(f"Adding column {col_name}...")
+                cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE customer_claims ADD {col_name} {col_type}")
+                print(f"Column {col_name} added successfully")
+            else:
+                print(f"Column {col_name} already exists")
+        
+        conn.commit()
+        print("Migration completed successfully!")
+        
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"Error during migration: {e}")
+        if conn:
+            conn.rollback()
+    finally:
+        if conn:
+            conn.close()
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    add_missing_columns()

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+"""
+Migration script to create claim module tables:
+- customer_claims
+- cabinet_prices  
+- container_shipments
+"""
+
+from sqlalchemy import text
+from config.database import engine, SessionLocal
+
+def upgrade():
+    """Create claim module tables if they don't exist"""
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    
+    try:
+        # Check if customer_claims table exists
+        customer_claims_check = db.execute(text("""
+            SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
+            WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'customer_claims'
+        """)).fetchone()
+        
+        if not customer_claims_check:
+            print("Creating customer_claims table...")
+            db.execute(text("""
+                CREATE TABLE customer_claims (
+                    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
+                    claim_code NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+                    customer_name NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
+                    product_name NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
+                    order_code NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
+                    company_error_code NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
+                    description NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
+                    severity NVARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'Medium',
+                    status NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Received',
+                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE(),
+                    resolved_at DATETIME NULL
+                )
+            """))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_customer_claims_claim_code ON customer_claims (claim_code)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_customer_claims_status ON customer_claims (status)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_customer_claims_created_at ON customer_claims (created_at)"))
+            db.commit()
+            print("Successfully created customer_claims table and indexes.")
+        else:
+            print("customer_claims table already exists.")
+        
+        # Check if cabinet_prices table exists
+        cabinet_prices_check = db.execute(text("""
+            SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
+            WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'cabinet_prices'
+        """)).fetchone()
+        
+        if not cabinet_prices_check:
+            print("Creating cabinet_prices table...")
+            db.execute(text("""
+                CREATE TABLE cabinet_prices (
+                    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
+                    cabinet_code NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+                    cabinet_name NVARCHAR(150) NOT NULL,
+                    material NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
+                    dimensions NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
+                    base_price FLOAT NOT NULL,
+                    sale_price FLOAT NOT NULL,
+                    status NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Active',
+                    last_updated DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
+                )
+            """))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_cabinet_prices_cabinet_code ON cabinet_prices (cabinet_code)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_cabinet_prices_status ON cabinet_prices (status)"))
+            db.commit()
+            print("Successfully created cabinet_prices table and indexes.")
+        else:
+            print("cabinet_prices table already exists.")
+        
+        # Check if container_shipments table exists
+        container_shipments_check = db.execute(text("""
+            SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
+            WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'container_shipments'
+        """)).fetchone()
+        
+        if not container_shipments_check:
+            print("Creating container_shipments table...")
+            db.execute(text("""
+                CREATE TABLE container_shipments (
+                    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
+                    shipment_code NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
+                    container_number NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
+                    seal_number NVARCHAR(50) NULL,
+                    destination_port NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
+                    etd DATETIME NULL,
+                    eta DATETIME NULL,
+                    status NVARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'Draft',
+                    total_value FLOAT DEFAULT 0.0,
+                    created_at DATETIME DEFAULT GETDATE()
+                )
+            """))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_container_shipments_shipment_code ON container_shipments (shipment_code)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_container_shipments_container_number ON container_shipments (container_number)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_container_shipments_status ON container_shipments (status)"))
+            db.execute(text("CREATE INDEX ix_container_shipments_created_at ON container_shipments (created_at)"))

+            print("Successfully created container_shipments table and indexes.")
+        else:
+            print("container_shipments table already exists.")
+            
+        print("Claim module tables migration completed successfully.")
+        
+    except Exception as e:
+        db.rollback()
+        print(f"Error creating claim tables: {e}")
+        raise
+    finally:
+        db.close()
+
+def downgrade():
+    """Drop claim module tables"""
+    db = SessionLocal()
+    
+    try:
+        print("Dropping claim module tables...")
+        
+        # Drop tables in reverse order of creation (due to potential foreign keys)
+        db.execute(text("DROP TABLE IF EXISTS container_shipments"))

+        raise
+    finally:
+        db.close()
+

+    upgrade()

+import time
+
+COOLDOWNS = {}
+
+def is_service_cooldown(service_name: str) -> bool:
+    expiry = COOLDOWNS.get(service_name, 0)
+    if time.time() < expiry:
+        remaining = int(expiry - time.time())
+        logger.info(f"[Circuit Breaker] Bo qua goi {service_name} (Thoi gian hoi: con {remaining} giay)")
+        return True
+    return False
+
+def set_service_cooldown(service_name: str, seconds: int = 60):
+    COOLDOWNS[service_name] = time.time() + seconds
+    logger.warning(f"[Circuit Breaker] Thiet lap thoi gian hoi cho {service_name} trong {seconds} giay do loi/rate limit/timeout.")

+                    "container_no": item.container_no,
+                    "cont": item.container_no,
+                    "lpn": item.lpn,
+                    "image_paths": item.image_paths,
+                    "image_captions": item.image_captions,
+                    "status": item.status,
+                    "severity": item.severity,
+                    "company_error_code": item.company_error_code,
+                    "stt": getattr(item, 'stt', None)
+                })
+        except Exception as db_err:
+            logger.error(f"Error loading claims from database: {db_err}")
+        
+        return claims
+    except Exception as e:
+        logger.error(f"Error loading claims for chatbot: {e}")
+        return []
+
+def normalize_claim_record(r: dict, db = None) -> dict:
+    """
+    Normalizes a claim record dict to standard keys and resolves aliases.
+    """
+    cabinet_no = r.get("cabinet_no")
+    claim_code = r.get("claim_code") or r.get("claim_item")
+    if not claim_code and cabinet_no is not None:
+        claim_code = f"Cabinet #{cabinet_no}"
+    elif claim_code and cabinet_no is None:
+        # Try different formats for cabinet_no extraction
+        match = re.search(r'Cabinet\s*#\s*(\d+)', str(claim_code), re.IGNORECASE)
+        if match:
+            cabinet_no = int(match.group(1))
+        else:
+            # Try CLAIM-CABINET1-1 format
+            match = re.search(r'CABINET(\d+)', str(claim_code), re.IGNORECASE)
+            if match:
+                cabinet_no = int(match.group(1))
+            
+    sku = r.get("sku") or r.get("product_name") or ""
+    product_name = sku
+    
+    defect_code = r.get("defect_code") or r.get("order_code") or ""
+    order_code = defect_code
+    
+    description = r.get("description") or r.get("claim_description") or ""
+    claim_description = description
+    
+    action = r.get("action") or r.get("penalty") or ""
+    penalty = action
+    
+    period = r.get("period") or r.get("date") or ""
+    date = period
+    
+    container = r.get("container") or r.get("container_no") or r.get("cont") or ""
+    container_no = container
+    cont = container
+    
+    lpn = r.get("lpn") or ""
+    
+    # Normalize image paths to absolute static URLs
+    raw_images = r.get("image_paths") or []
+    image_paths = []
+    for img in raw_images:
+        if not img:
+            continue
+        if img.startswith("/api/v1/claims/"):
+            image_paths.append(img)
+        else:
+            clean_img = img.replace("\\", "/").lstrip("/")
+            if clean_img.startswith("claim_imports/"):
+                image_paths.append(f"/api/v1/claims/{clean_img}")
+            else:
+                image_paths.append(f"/api/v1/claims/claim_imports/{clean_img}")
+                
+    image_captions = r.get("image_captions") or []
+    status = r.get("status") or "Mß╗¢i"
+    severity = r.get("severity") or "Low"
+    company_error_code = r.get("company_error_code") or ""
+    parse_warnings = r.get("parse_warnings") or []
+    capa_link = r.get("capa_link") or r.get("link_capa") or ""
+    
+    # Tß╗▒ ─æß╗Öng lß║Ñy T├¬n lß╗ùi tiß║┐ng Viß╗çt tß╗½ database nß║┐u c├óu query kh├┤ng JOIN vß╗¢i client_defects
+    defect_name = r.get("defect_name") or r.get("name") or ""
+    if not defect_name and db and order_code:
+        try:
+            codes = [c.strip() for c in str(order_code).split(",") if c.strip()]
+            if codes:
+                from modules.inspection.models.defect_type import ClientDefect
+                defect_records = db.query(ClientDefect).filter(ClientDefect.code.in_(codes)).all()
+                if defect_records:
+                    defect_name = ", ".join([d.name for d in defect_records if d.name])
+        except Exception as db_err:
+            logger.warning(f"Error looking up defect name: {db_err}")
+    
+    return {
+        "id": r.get("id"),
+        "cabinet_no": cabinet_no,
+        "claim_code": claim_code,
+        "product_name": product_name,
+        "sku": sku,
+        "order_code": order_code,
+        "defect_code": defect_code,
+        "defect_name": defect_name,
+        "description": description,
+        "claim_description": claim_description,
+        "action": action,
+        "penalty": penalty,
+        "period": period,
+        "date": date,
+        "container": container,
+        "container_no": container_no,
+        "cont": cont,
+        "lpn": lpn,
+        "image_paths": image_paths,
+        "image_captions": image_captions,
+        "status": status,
+        "severity": severity,
+        "company_error_code": company_error_code,
+        "parse_warnings": parse_warnings,
+        "capa_link": capa_link
+    }
+
+def is_asking_for_details(message: str) -> bool:
+    """
+    Checks if the user message is asking for details.
+    """
+    msg = message.lower()
+    keywords = ["chi tiß║┐t", "chi tiet", "danh s├ích", "danh sach", "liß╗çt k├¬", "liet ke", "show details", "details", "list", "detail"]
+    return any(k in msg for k in keywords)
+
+def is_follow_up_message(message: str) -> bool:
+    """
+    Checks if the message refers to pronouns/entities in the previous context.
+    """
+    msg = message.lower()
+    
+    pronouns = [
+        "n├│", "no",
+        "tß╗º ─æ├│", "tu do", "tß╗º ─æo",
+        "c├íi ─æ├│", "cai do",
+        "claim ─æ├│", "claim do",
+        "d├▓ng ─æ├│", "dong do",
+        "m├ú ─æ├│", "ma do",
+        "ß║únh cß╗ºa n├│", "anh cua no",
+        "h├¼nh cß╗ºa n├│", "hinh cua no",
+        "c├▓n c├íi n├áy", "con cai nay",
+        "─æß╗æi vß╗¢i tß╗º ─æ├│ th├¼ sao", "doi voi tu do thi sao",
+        "tß╗º n├áy", "tu nay",
+        "d├▓ng n├áy", "dong nay",
+        "claim n├áy", "claim nay",
+        "m├ú n├áy", "ma nay",
+        "lß╗ùi ─æ├│", "loi do",
+        "lß╗ùi n├áy", "loi nay",
+        "ß║únh lß╗ùi", "anh loi", "h├¼nh lß╗ùi", "hinh loi"
+    ]
+    if any(p in msg for p in pronouns):
+        return True
+        
+    pure_commands = [
+        "chi tiß║┐t", "chi tiet", "d├▓ng ─æß║ºu", "dong dau", "d├▓ng ─æ├│", "dong do",
+        "c├│ ß║únh kh├┤ng", "co anh khong", "c├│ h├¼nh kh├┤ng", "co hinh khong",
+        "xem ß║únh", "xem anh", "xem h├¼nh", "xem hinh", "ß║únh ─æ├óu", "anh dau", "h├¼nh ─æ├óu", "hinh dau",
+        "action l├á g├¼", "action la gi", "biß╗çn ph├íp l├á g├¼", "bien phap la gi", "phß║ít g├¼", "phat gi",
+        "biß╗çn ph├íp g├¼", "bien phap gi", "capa l├á g├¼", "capa la gi", "xin capa", "link capa"
+    ]
+    if any(c in msg for c in pure_commands):
+        return True
+        
+    return False
+
+def is_context_empty(context: dict) -> bool:
+    """
+    Checks if the given context has no active filters/items stored.
+    """
+    if not context:
+        return True
+    
+    has_entity = (
+        context.get("last_cabinet_no") is not None or
+        context.get("last_sku") or
+        context.get("last_period") or
+        context.get("last_defect_code") or
+        context.get("last_action") or
+        context.get("last_container") or
+        context.get("last_lpn") or
+        context.get("last_status") or
+        context.get("last_severity") or
+        context.get("last_items") or
+        context.get("last_intent")
+    )
+    return not has_entity
+
+def _update_context_with_filters(context: dict, filters: dict):
+    """
+    Helper function to update context with filters.
+    """
+    if not filters:
+        return
+    if "cabinet_no" in filters and filters["cabinet_no"] is not None:
+        context["last_cabinet_no"] = filters["cabinet_no"]
+    if "sku" in filters and filters["sku"]:
+        context["last_sku"] = filters["sku"]
+    if "period" in filters and filters["period"]:
+        context["last_period"] = filters["period"]
+    elif ("month" in filters and filters["month"]) or ("year" in filters and filters["year"]):
+        month = filters.get("month", "")
+        year = filters.get("year", "")
+        if month and year:
+            context["last_period"] = f"{int(month):02d}-{year}"
+        elif year:
+            context["last_period"] = f"%-{year}"
+    if "defect_code" in filters and filters["defect_code"]:
+        context["last_defect_code"] = filters["defect_code"]
+    if "action" in filters and filters["action"]:
+        context["last_action"] = filters["action"]
+    if "container_no" in filters and filters["container_no"]:
+        context["last_container"] = filters["container_no"]
+    if "lpn" in filters and filters["lpn"]:
+        context["last_lpn"] = filters["lpn"]
+    if "status" in filters and filters["status"]:
+        context["last_status"] = filters["status"]
+    if "severity" in filters and filters["severity"]:
+        context["last_severity"] = filters["severity"]
+
+def _should_normalize_as_claim(item: dict) -> bool:
+    """
+    Checks if a dictionary item resembles a customer claim record.
+    Returns True if it has typical claim identifiers, False otherwise.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(item, dict):
+        return False
+    claim_keys = {"claim_code", "product_name", "order_code", "lpn", "container_no"}
+    return any(k in item for k in claim_keys)
+
+def _update_context_with_entity_details(context: dict, item: dict):
+    """
+    Updates context with specific entity identification details from a matched database record.
+    Does NOT update query filters like status, severity, action, or period to prevent pollution.
+    """
+    if not item or not isinstance(item, dict):
+        return
+        
+    # Only update specific entity identifiers
+    if "cabinet_no" in item and item["cabinet_no"] is not None:
+        context["last_cabinet_no"] = item["cabinet_no"]
+    elif "claim_code" in item and item["claim_code"]:
+        m = re.search(r'#?\s*(\d+)', item["claim_code"])
+        if m:
+            context["last_cabinet_no"] = int(m.group(1))
+            
+    if "sku" in item and item["sku"]:
+        context["last_sku"] = item["sku"]
+    elif "product_name" in item and item["product_name"]:
+        context["last_sku"] = item["product_name"]
+        
+    if "container_no" in item and item["container_no"]:
+        context["last_container"] = item["container_no"]
+    elif "container" in item and item["container"]:
+        context["last_container"] = item["container"]
+        
+    if "lpn" in item and item["lpn"]:
+        context["last_lpn"] = item["lpn"]
+
+def _call_cloud_ai_fallback(message: str, db, context: dict, active_history: list) -> dict:
+    # 1. Thß╗¡ GitHub Models (GPT-4o-mini)
+    if github_chatbot_service.is_available():
+        try:
+            logger.info("[Fallback] ─Éang gß╗ìi GitHub Models (GPT-4o-mini)...")
+            res = github_chatbot_service.chat_with_ai(message, db, context, active_history)
+            if res and res.get("intent") != "error":
+                return res
+            else:
+                logger.warning(f"[Fallback] GitHub Models trß║ú lß╗ùi: {res.get('message') if res else 'None'}")
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"[Fallback] Lß╗ùi khi gß╗ìi GitHub Models: {e}")
+            
+    # 2. Thß╗¡ Groq (Llama 3.3 70B)
+    if groq_chatbot_service.is_available():
+        try:
+            logger.info("[Fallback] ─Éang gß╗ìi Groq (Llama 3.3 70B)...")
+            res = groq_chatbot_service.chat_with_ai(message, db, context, active_history)
+            if res and res.get("intent") != "error":
+                return res
+            else:
+                logger.warning(f"[Fallback] Groq trß║ú lß╗ùi: {res.get('message') if res else 'None'}")
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"[Fallback] Lß╗ùi khi gß╗ìi Groq: {e}")
+            
+    # 3. Thß╗¡ OpenRouter
+    if openrouter_chatbot_service.is_available():
+        try:
+            logger.info("[Fallback] ─Éang gß╗ìi OpenRouter...")
+            res = openrouter_chatbot_service.chat_with_ai(message, db, context, active_history)
+            if res and res.get("intent") != "error":
+                return res
+            else:
+                logger.warning(f"[Fallback] OpenRouter trß║ú lß╗ùi: {res.get('message') if res else 'None'}")
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"[Fallback] Lß╗ùi khi gß╗ìi OpenRouter: {e}")
+            
+    return None
+
+
+def _process_ai_response(ai_res: dict, message: str, db, context: dict, user_id: int, session_id: str = "default", session_title: str = None) -> dict:
+    raw_items = ai_res.get("items") or []
+    normalized_items = []
+    for item in raw_items:
+        if isinstance(item, dict):
+            try:
+               if _should_normalize_as_claim(item):
+                   normalized_items.append(normalize_claim_record(item, db))
+               else:
+                   normalized_items.append(item)
+            except Exception as norm_err:
+                logger.warning(f"Error normalizing retrieved item: {norm_err}")
+                normalized_items.append(item)
+        else:
+            normalized_items.append(item)
+    
+    # Cß║¡p nhß║¡t context tß╗½ bß║ún ghi ─æß║ºu ti├¬n nß║┐u c├│
+    if normalized_items:
+        _update_context_with_entity_details(context, normalized_items[0])
+    
+    ans_text = ai_res.get("message") or ""
+    
+    # L╞░u c├óu trß║ú lß╗¥i cß╗ºa AI v├áo database
+    if db is not None and user_id is not None:
+        try:
+            from modules.chatbot.models.chatbot_history import ChatbotHistory
+            bot_msg = ChatbotHistory(
+                account_id=user_id,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                session_title=session_title,
+                role="assistant",
+                content=ans_text,
+                items_json=json.dumps(normalized_items, ensure_ascii=False),
+                suggestions_json=json.dumps([], ensure_ascii=False),
+                context_json=json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False)
+            )
+            db.add(bot_msg)
+            db.commit()
+        except Exception as save_err:
+            logger.error(f"Error saving AI message to DB: {save_err}")
+            
+    return {
+        "answer": ans_text,
+        "intent": "ai_agent",
+        "filters": {},
+        "matched_count": len(normalized_items),
+        "items": normalized_items,
+        "suggestions": [],
+        "context": context,
+        "source": ai_res.get("source", "unknown")
+    }
+
+
+def handle_claim_chat(message: str, context: dict = None, db = None, history: list = None, current_user = None, session_id: str = "default") -> dict:
+    """
+    Chatbot entrypoint. Tß║úi lß╗ïch sß╗¡ tin nhß║»n tß╗½ database cho ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng hiß╗çn tß║íi (nß║┐u c├│),
+    chß╗ë gß╗ìi AI Local (Ollama) v├á l╞░u tin nhß║»n mß╗¢i v├áo SQL Server.
+    Nß║┐u AI Local gß║╖p sß╗▒ cß╗æ hoß║╖c ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng y├¬u cß║ºu r├╡ r├áng, tß╗▒ ─æß╗Öng chuyß╗ân sang Cloud AI (GitHub, Groq...).
+    Nß║┐u tß║Ñt cß║ú ─æß╗üu lß╗ùi, tß╗▒ ─æß╗Öng fallback vß╗ü Rule-based chatbot.
+    """
+    if context is None:
+        context = {}
+    if history is None:
+        history = []
+        
+    user_id = current_user.id if current_user else None
+    
+    # 1. Tß║úi lß╗ïch sß╗¡ chat tß╗½ database cß╗ºa ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng hiß╗çn tß║íi cho phi├¬n n├áy (lß║Ñy tß╗æi ─æa 15 tin nhß║»n gß║ºn nhß║Ñt)
+    db_history = []
+    if db is not None and user_id is not None:
+        try:
+            from modules.chatbot.models.chatbot_history import ChatbotHistory
+            histories = db.query(ChatbotHistory).filter(
+                ChatbotHistory.account_id == user_id,
+                ChatbotHistory.session_id == session_id
+            ).order_by(ChatbotHistory.created_at.asc()).all()
+            
+            for h in histories[-15:]:
+                role_val = h.role if h.role in ["user", "assistant"] else "assistant"
+                db_history.append({
+                    "role": role_val,
+                    "content": h.content
+                })
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"Error loading chat history from DB: {e}")
+            
+    # ╞»u ti├¬n lß╗ïch sß╗¡ lß║Ñy tß╗½ DB, nß║┐u trß╗æng mß╗¢i d├╣ng history truyß╗ün v├áo (cho t╞░╞íng th├¡ch ng╞░ß╗úc)
+    active_history = db_history if db_history else history
+
+    # 2. L╞░u c├óu hß╗Åi cß╗ºa ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng v├áo database
+    title = None
+    if db is not None and user_id is not None:
+        try:
+            from modules.chatbot.models.chatbot_history import ChatbotHistory
+            existing_session = db.query(ChatbotHistory).filter(
+                ChatbotHistory.account_id == user_id,
+                ChatbotHistory.session_id == session_id
+            ).first()
+            
+            if not existing_session:
+                title = message[:50] + "..." if len(message) > 50 else message
+            else:
+                title = existing_session.session_title
+                
+            user_msg = ChatbotHistory(
+                account_id=user_id,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                session_title=title,
+                role="user",
+                content=message,
+                context_json=json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False)
+            )
+            db.add(user_msg)
+            db.commit()
+        except Exception as save_err:
+            logger.error(f"Error saving user message to DB: {save_err}")
+            
+            
+    # [IMAGE GENERATION INTEGRATION]
+    msg_lower = message.lower().strip()
+    image_keywords = ["vß║╜", "tß║ío ß║únh", "tß║ío h├¼nh", "generate image", "gen ß║únh", "gen anh", "vß║╜ h├¼nh", "ve hinh", "vß║╜ tranh", "ve tranh", "dß╗▒ng h├¼nh", "draw"]
+    chart_keywords = ["biß╗âu ─æß╗ô", "bieu do", "─æß╗ô thß╗ï", "do thi", "chart", "diagram", "pareto", "c╞í cß║Ñu", "co cau", "tß╗╖ lß╗ç", "ty le", "pie", "bar", "line"]
+    
+    is_image_request = False
+    for kw in image_keywords:
+        if kw in msg_lower:
+            is_image_request = True
+            break
+            
+    # Bß╗Å qua image generator nß║┐u c├óu hß╗Åi thß╗▒c chß║Ñt l├á y├¬u cß║ºu vß║╜ biß╗âu ─æß╗ô/─æß╗ô thß╗ï
+    if is_image_request:
+        for ckw in chart_keywords:
+            if ckw in msg_lower:
+                is_image_request = False
+                break
+            
+    if is_image_request:
+        import urllib.parse
+        import uuid
+        import requests
+        
+        # Tr├¡ch xuß║Ñt m├┤ tß║ú chi tiß║┐t tß╗½ tin nhß║»n
+        clean_prompt = message
+        for kw in image_keywords:
+            clean_prompt = re.sub(rf'\b{kw}\b', '', clean_prompt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
+        # Loß║íi bß╗Å c├íc tß╗½ nß╗æi v├á phß╗Ñ tß╗½ phß╗ò biß║┐n ─æß╗â c├│ prompt sß║ích
+        fillers = ["hß╗Ö t├┤i", "cho t├┤i", "ß║únh", "h├¼nh", "tranh", "vß║╜", "c├íi", "mß╗Öt", "bß╗⌐c", "chi tiß║┐t", "vß╗ü", "vß║╜ mß╗Öt", "vß║╜ bß╗⌐c", "thiß║┐t kß║┐", "thiet ke"]
+        for f in fillers:
+            clean_prompt = re.sub(rf'\b{f}\b', '', clean_prompt, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
+        clean_prompt = clean_prompt.strip()
+        if not clean_prompt:
+            clean_prompt = "beautiful wooden cabinet design, high detail"
+            
+        # Encode URL
+        encoded_prompt = urllib.parse.quote(clean_prompt)
+        # Sß╗¡ dß╗Ñng API cß╗ºa Pollinations ─æß╗â generate ß║únh chß║Ñt l╞░ß╗úng cao
+        image_url = f"https://image.pollinations.ai/prompt/{encoded_prompt}?width=1024&height=768&nologo=true"
+        
+        # L╞░u ß║únh vß╗ü server local ─æß╗â l╞░u trß╗» ß╗òn ─æß╗ïnh
+        static_gen_dir = os.path.join(STATIC_DIR, "generated_images")
+        os.makedirs(static_gen_dir, exist_ok=True)
+        filename = f"gen_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}.jpg"
+        filepath = os.path.join(static_gen_dir, filename)
+        local_url = f"/static/generated_images/{filename}"
+        
+        try:
+            response = requests.get(image_url, timeout=30)
+            if response.status_code == 200:
+                with open(filepath, "wb") as f:
+                    f.write(response.content)
+            else:
+                local_url = image_url
+        except Exception as img_err:
+            logger.error(f"Error saving generated image: {img_err}")
+            local_url = image_url
+            
+        ans_text = f"D╞░ß╗¢i ─æ├óy l├á h├¼nh ß║únh thiß║┐t kß║┐ **{clean_prompt}** ─æ╞░ß╗úc tß║ío tß╗▒ ─æß╗Öng theo y├¬u cß║ºu cß╗ºa bß║ín:\n\n![{clean_prompt}]({local_url})"

+                from modules.chatbot.models.chatbot_history import ChatbotHistory

+                    account_id=user_id,

+                    suggestions_json=json.dumps([], ensure_ascii=False),
+                    context_json=json.dumps(context, ensure_ascii=False)

+                db.add(bot_msg)
+                db.commit()
+            except Exception as save_err:
+                logger.error(f"Error saving AI image response to DB: {save_err}")
+                
+        return {
+            "answer": ans_text,
+            "intent": "generate_image",
+            "filters": {},
+            "matched_count": 0,
+            "items": [],
+            "suggestions": [
+                "Vß║╜ thiß║┐t kß║┐ tß╗º bß║┐p gß╗ù sß╗ôi cß╗ò ─æiß╗ân",
+                "Vß║╜ tß╗º quß║ºn ├ío hiß╗çn ─æß║íi c├ính k├¡nh ├óm led",

+            filters["status"] = context["last_status"]

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+from sqlalchemy import Column, Integer, String, DateTime
+from sqlalchemy.dialects.mssql import NVARCHAR
+from datetime import datetime
+from config.database import Base
+
+class ChatbotContext(Base):
+    """
+    Model l╞░u trß╗» context memory cho chatbot claim
+    """
+    __tablename__ = "chatbot_contexts"
+
+    id = Column(Integer, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    session_id = Column(NVARCHAR(100), unique=True, index=True, nullable=False)
+    last_cabinet_no = Column(NVARCHAR(50), nullable=True)
+    last_sku = Column(NVARCHAR(100), nullable=True)
+    last_period = Column(NVARCHAR(20), nullable=True)
+    last_defect_code = Column(NVARCHAR(100), nullable=True)
+    last_action = Column(NVARCHAR(100), nullable=True)
+    last_container = Column(NVARCHAR(50), nullable=True)
+    last_lpn = Column(NVARCHAR(50), nullable=True)
+    last_status = Column(NVARCHAR(50), nullable=True)
+    last_severity = Column(NVARCHAR(20), nullable=True)
+    last_intent = Column(NVARCHAR(50), nullable=True)
+    last_items = Column(NVARCHAR(2000), nullable=True)  # JSON string of last items
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.now)
+    updated_at = Column(DateTime, default=datetime.now, onupdate=datetime.now)

+SQL Mß║¬U ΓÇö Tß╗öNG TIß╗ÇN PHß║áT (c├│ JOIN cabinet_prices):
+SELECT 
+  SUM(CASE
+    WHEN c.action LIKE '$%' 
+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_tien_phat
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+WHERE c.period = '02-2025'   -- thay ─æß╗òi ─æiß╗üu kiß╗çn theo c├óu hß╗Åi

+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_gia_tri
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)

+class AIChatbotService:
+    """AI Chatbot service using new Google GenAI SDK (google-genai) with database query tools."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.api_keys = [
+            k for k in [
+                os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY"),
+                os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY_BACKUP"),
+                os.getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY_BACKUP2"),
+            ] if k
+        ]
+        self.current_key_index = 0
+        self.client = None
+        self.max_retries = 2
+        self.retry_delay = 1  # seconds
+        self._init_client()
+
+    def _init_client(self) -> bool:
+        """Initialize client with the current key. Returns True if successful."""
+        if not self.api_keys:
+            logger.warning("No GEMINI_API_KEY found in environment variables")
+            return False
+        api_key = self.api_keys[self.current_key_index]
+        try:
+            self.client = genai.Client(api_key=api_key)
+            logger.info(f"Gemini client initialized (key index {self.current_key_index})")
+            return True
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"Failed to initialize GenAI client with key index {self.current_key_index}: {e}")
+            return False
+
+    def _rotate_key(self) -> bool:
+        """Try rotating to the next available API key. Returns True if rotated successfully."""
+        next_index = self.current_key_index + 1
+        if next_index < len(self.api_keys):
+            logger.warning(f"Gemini key index {self.current_key_index} quota exceeded. Rotating to key index {next_index}.")
+            self.current_key_index = next_index
+            return self._init_client()
+        logger.error("All Gemini API keys have been exhausted.")
+        return False
+
+    def is_available(self) -> bool:
+        """Check if Gemini API is available."""
+        return bool(self.api_keys)
+
+    # ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Tool Functions ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ
+    # These are defined as static/module-level helpers; at call-time we
+    # bind the live db_session via a thin wrapper (see chat_with_ai).
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get_database_schema() -> str:
+        """
+        Returns the schema representation of key tables in the database
+        (columns, data types, and keys).
+        Use this to understand the structure of tables before running queries.
+        """
+        return DB_SCHEMA
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _get_current_datetime() -> str:
+        """
+        Returns the current date and time on the server.
+        Use this to resolve relative dates like 'today', 'this month', 'last week'.
+        """
+        return datetime.now().strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _execute_read_only_query(sql_query: str, db_session, captured_items: list) -> str:
+        """
+        Executes a read-only SQL query on the SQL Server database and returns results as JSON.
+        Only SELECT statements are allowed.
+        When the user asks for a count or total number, you MUST use SELECT COUNT(*).
+        This tool returns ALL rows from the database without any limit.
+        """
+        cleaned = sql_query.strip()
+
+        # Security checks ΓÇô block all write/admin keywords
+        forbidden = [
+            r"\bINSERT\b", r"\bUPDATE\b", r"\bDELETE\b", r"\bDROP\b",
+            r"\bALTER\b", r"\bCREATE\b", r"\bTRUNCATE\b", r"\bRENAME\b",
+            r"\bEXEC\b", r"\bEXECUTE\b", r"\bGRANT\b", r"\bREVOKE\b",
+            r"--", r";"
+        ]
+        for pat in forbidden:
+            if re.search(pat, cleaned, re.IGNORECASE):
+                return json.dumps({"error": "Security violation: Keyword/character not allowed in read-only queries."})
+
+        if not cleaned.upper().startswith("SELECT"):
+            return json.dumps({"error": "Security violation: Query must be a SELECT statement."})
+
+        if not db_session:
+            return json.dumps({"error": "Database session is not available."})
+
+        try:
+            from sqlalchemy import text
+            print(f"\n[AI_SQL] CHß║áY Lß╗åNH: {cleaned}")
+            try:
+                with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                    f.write(f"\n--- GEMINI {datetime.now().isoformat()} ---\n")
+                    f.write(f"Query: {cleaned}\n")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+            result = db_session.execute(text(cleaned))
+
+            if result.returns_rows:
+                keys = list(result.keys())
+                rows = result.fetchall()  # No limit ΓÇö fetch all rows
+                data = []
+                for row in rows:
+                    row_dict = {}
+                    for idx, col in enumerate(keys):
+                        val = row[idx]
+                        if isinstance(val, datetime):
+                            row_dict[col] = val.isoformat()
+                        else:
+                            row_dict[col] = val
+                    data.append(row_dict)
+
+                total_rows = len(data)
+                print(f"[AI_SQL] Kß║╛T QUß║ó TRß║ó Vß╗Ç: {total_rows} d├▓ng")
+
+                try:
+                    with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                        f.write(f"Result count: {total_rows}\n")
+                        if total_rows > 0:
+                            f.write(f"First row: {str(data[0])}\n")
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+
+                # Capture claims data for UI card display
+                if "customer_claims" in cleaned.lower():
+                    if data and "claim_code" in data[0]:
+                        captured_items.extend(data)
+
+                # If too many rows for LLM context, truncate the data
+                # but always tell AI the real total count
+                if total_rows > 50:
+                    truncated = data[:50]
+                    return json.dumps({
+                        "_total_rows_in_database": total_rows,
+                        "_showing_first": 50,
+                        "_note": f"Query returned {total_rows} rows total. Only first 50 are shown below. Use this total count ({total_rows}) when answering the user.",
+                        "rows": truncated
+                    }, ensure_ascii=False)
+
+                return json.dumps(data, ensure_ascii=False)
+            else:
+                try:
+                    with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                        f.write(f"Result count: 0 (No rows returned)\n")
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+                return json.dumps({"message": "Query executed successfully, returned no rows."})
+        except Exception as e:
+            logger.error(f"SQL execution error from Chatbot Agent: {e}")
+            try:
+                with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                    f.write(f"Error: {str(e)}\n")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            return json.dumps({"error": f"Database Error: {str(e)}"})
+
+    def chat_with_ai(self, user_message: str, db_session=None, context: Dict[str, Any] = None, history: list = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+        """
+        Generate AI response using Google Gemini Agent with Database Tools.
+
+        Uses the new google-genai SDK with client.chats.create() for
+        automatic function calling. Supports automatic API key rotation
+        when quota is exceeded.
+        """
+        # Lazy-init client if not yet initialized
+        if not self.client:
+            if not self._init_client():
+                return {
+                    "answer": "AI ChatBot ch╞░a ─æ╞░ß╗úc cß║Ñu h├¼nh. Vui l├▓ng th├¬m GEMINI_API_KEY v├áo file .env",
+                    "intent": "error",
+                    "items": [],
+                    "context": context or {}
+                }
+
+        if context is None:
+            context = {}
+
+        gemini_history = []
+        if history:
+            for h in history:
+                role = "user" if h.get("role") == "user" else "model"
+                gemini_history.append(
+                    {"role": role, "parts": [{"text": h.get("content")}]}
+                )
+
+        captured_items: list = []
+
+        # ΓöÇΓöÇ Build thin wrappers that close over db_session & captured_items ΓöÇΓöÇ
+        def get_database_schema() -> str:
+            """Returns the schema representation of key tables in the database (columns, data types, and keys). Use this to understand the structure of tables before running queries."""
+            return self._get_database_schema()
+
+        def execute_read_only_query(sql_query: str) -> str:
+            """Executes a read-only SQL SELECT query on the SQL Server database and returns results as JSON. Only SELECT statements are allowed. All write operations are forbidden. IMPORTANT: When the user asks about counts or totals (e.g. 'bao nhi├¬u', 'tß╗òng sß╗æ'), you MUST use SELECT COUNT(*) instead of SELECT *. The result will include _total_rows_in_database showing the exact total count from the database."""
+            return self._execute_read_only_query(sql_query, db_session, captured_items)
+
+        def get_current_datetime() -> str:
+            """Returns the current date and time on the server. Use this to resolve relative dates like 'today', 'this month', 'last week'."""
+            return self._get_current_datetime()
+
+        # Retry logic with automatic key rotation on quota errors
+        last_error = None
+        total_attempts = (self.max_retries + 1) * len(self.api_keys)
+        for attempt in range(total_attempts):
+            try:
+                # Build user prompt with conversation context
+                context_str = ""
+                if context:
+                    parts = []
+                    for k, v in context.items():
+                        if v is not None and not k.startswith("last_items"):
+                            parts.append(f"- {k}: {v}")
+                    if parts:
+                        context_str = "\n\nNgß╗» cß║únh cuß╗Öc hß╗Öi thoß║íi tr╞░ß╗¢c ─æ├│:\n" + "\n".join(parts)
+
+                full_prompt = user_message
+                if context_str:
+                    full_prompt = f"[{context_str.strip()}]\n\nC├óu hß╗Åi: {user_message}"
+
+                # Create chat with Automatic Function Calling via new SDK
+                chat = self.client.chats.create(
+                    model="gemini-2.0-flash",  # Upgraded: faster & smarter than gemini-1.0-pro
+                    history=gemini_history,
+                    config=types.GenerateContentConfig(
+                        system_instruction=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
+                        temperature=0.2,
+                        max_output_tokens=1500,
+                        tools=[get_database_schema, execute_read_only_query, get_current_datetime],
+                        automatic_function_calling=types.AutomaticFunctionCallingConfig(
+                            disable=False
+                        ),
+                    ),
+                )
+
+                response = chat.send_message(full_prompt)
+                answer = response.text
+
+                # Update conversation context from captured items
+                if captured_items:
+                    ref = captured_items[0]
+                    if ref.get("cabinet_no") is not None:
+                        context["last_cabinet_no"] = ref["cabinet_no"]
+                    if ref.get("product_name"):
+                        context["last_sku"] = ref["product_name"]
+                    if ref.get("period"):
+                        context["last_period"] = ref["period"]
+                    if ref.get("order_code"):
+                        context["last_defect_code"] = ref["order_code"]
+                    if ref.get("action"):
+                        context["last_action"] = ref["action"]
+                    if ref.get("container_no"):
+                        context["last_container"] = ref["container_no"]
+                    if ref.get("lpn"):
+                        context["last_lpn"] = ref["lpn"]
+                    if ref.get("status"):
+                        context["last_status"] = ref["status"]
+                    if ref.get("severity"):
+                        context["last_severity"] = ref["severity"]
+
+                return {
+                    "answer": answer,
+                    "intent": "ai_agent",
+                    "items": captured_items,
+                    "context": context,
+                }
+
+            except Exception as e:
+                from modules.chatbot.services.error_helper import clean_error_message
+                cleaned_err = clean_error_message(e)
+                last_error = cleaned_err
+                error_msg = str(e)
+
+                is_quota_error = (
+                    "429" in error_msg or
+                    "quota" in error_msg.lower() or
+                    "resource_exhausted" in error_msg.lower()
+                )
+                is_retryable = is_quota_error or (
+                    "503" in error_msg or
+                    "unavailable" in error_msg.lower()
+                )
+
+                if is_quota_error:
+                    # Try rotating to next API key before giving up
+                    logger.warning(f"Lß╗ùi hß║ín mß╗⌐c Gemini (Key {self.current_key_index}): \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m")
+                    if self._rotate_key():
+                        logger.info("─É├ú chuyß╗ân sang key Gemini dß╗▒ ph├▓ng, ─æang thß╗¡ lß║íi...")
+                        continue  # Retry immediately with new key
+                    else:
+                        logger.error("\033[91mTß║Ñt cß║ú key Gemini ─æ├ú hß║┐t hß║ín mß╗⌐c.\033[0m")
+                        break
+                elif is_retryable and attempt < self.max_retries:
+                    logger.warning(f"Lß╗ùi Gemini (Lß║ºn thß╗¡ {attempt + 1}): \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m. ─Éang thß╗¡ lß║íi sau {self.retry_delay}s...")
+                    time.sleep(self.retry_delay)
+                    continue
+                else:
+                    logger.error(f"Lß╗ùi chß║íy Gemini (Lß║ºn thß╗¡ {attempt + 1}): \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m")
+                    break
+
+        # If all retries and key rotations failed, return error
+        return {
+            "answer": f"Lß╗ùi khi kß║┐t nß╗æi AI: {str(last_error)}",
+            "intent": "error",
+            "items": [],
+            "context": context or {},
+        }

+SYSTEM_PROMPT = """Bß║ín l├á trß╗ú l├╜ AI SmartFlow chuy├¬n vß╗ü quß║ún l├╜ khiß║┐u nß║íi (claims) v├á dß╗» liß╗çu hß╗ç thß╗æng ERP cß╗ºa doanh nghiß╗çp sß║ún xuß║Ñt ─æß╗ô gß╗ù.
+
+Nhiß╗çm vß╗Ñ cß╗ºa bß║ín:
+1. Trß║ú lß╗¥i c├óu hß╗Åi vß╗ü to├án bß╗Ö dß╗» liß╗çu hß╗ç thß╗æng SmartFlow, bao gß╗ôm:
+    - Khiß║┐u nß║íi (customer_claims, cabinet_prices, container_shipments, client_defects)
+    - Sß║ún xuß║Ñt (product_plans, orders, products, master_products)
+    - B├án giao nß╗Öi bß╗Ö (deliveries, delivery_details)
+   - Kiß╗âm tra chß║Ñt l╞░ß╗úng (daily_inspection_records, daily_inspection_defects, input_inspections)
+   - KPI (kpis)
+2. Sß╗¡ dß╗Ñng c├┤ng cß╗Ñ execute_read_only_query ─æß╗â truy vß║Ñn dß╗» liß╗çu, kß╗â cß║ú JOIN nhiß╗üu bß║úng khi cß║ºn.
+3. Trß║ú lß╗¥i bß║▒ng tiß║┐ng Viß╗çt mß╗Öt c├ích tß╗▒ nhi├¬n, chuy├¬n nghiß╗çp, ngß║»n gß╗ìn.
+4. Khi ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng y├¬u cß║ºu xem danh s├ích claim cß╗Ñ thß╗â, Bß║«T BUß╗ÿC d├╣ng SELECT * FROM customer_claims ─æß╗â hß╗ç thß╗æng hiß╗ân thß╗ï dß║íng thß║╗ (card).
+
+QUAN TRß╗îNG Vß╗Ç HIß╗éN THß╗è:
+- Giao diß╗çn sß║╜ Tß╗░ ─Éß╗ÿNG hiß╗ân thß╗ï kß║┐t quß║ú claim d╞░ß╗¢i dß║íng c├íc card th├┤ng tin c├│ n├║t "Xem chi tiß║┐t".
+- Vß╗¢i dß╗» liß╗çu kh├┤ng phß║úi claim (production, KPI...), trß║ú lß╗¥i trß╗▒c tiß║┐p bß║▒ng v─ân bß║ún.
+- Kh├┤ng bao giß╗¥ liß╗çt k├¬ claim thß╗º c├┤ng nh╞░ "1. Tß╗º #51... 2. Tß╗º #49..." v├¼ giao diß╗çn ─æ├ú hiß╗ân thß╗ï card.
+
+V├ì Dß╗ñ ΓÇö CLAIM:
+- "Th├íng 2/2025 phß║ít bao nhi├¬u tiß╗ün?" ΓåÆ SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN action='$50' THEN 50 WHEN action='Full BC' THEN ... END) ΓåÆ hoß║╖c SELECT action, COUNT(*) FROM customer_claims WHERE period='02-2025' GROUP BY action
+- "N─âm 2025 c├│ bao nhi├¬u khiß║┐u nß║íi?" ΓåÆ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer_claims WHERE period LIKE '%-2025'
+- "Claim trong th├íng 2 gß╗ôm nhß╗»ng g├¼?" ΓåÆ SELECT action, COUNT(*) as so_luong, SUM(...) FROM customer_claims WHERE period='02-2025' GROUP BY action

+V├ì Dß╗ñ ΓÇö CROSS MODULE (nhiß╗üu bß║úng):
+- "Sß║ún phß║⌐m T060D-BC-WOA bß╗ï claim bao nhi├¬u lß║ºn, gi├í b├ín l├á bao nhi├¬u?" ΓåÆ 
+  SELECT c.product_name, COUNT(*) as claim_count, p.base_price, p.sale_price
+  FROM customer_claims c LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+  WHERE c.product_name LIKE '%T060D%' GROUP BY c.product_name, p.base_price, p.sale_price
+- "Container n├áo ─æang shipped c├│ claim?" ΓåÆ

+  FROM container_shipments s LEFT JOIN customer_claims c ON s.container_number = c.container_no
+  WHERE s.status='Shipped' GROUP BY s.container_number, s.status
+- "KPI th├íng 5 ─æß║ít kh├┤ng?" ΓåÆ SELECT content, target, actual, status FROM kpis WHERE period_name LIKE '%5%'
+- "Tß╗╖ lß╗ç lß╗ùi QC th├íng n├áy?" ΓåÆ SELECT stage_name, AVG(defect_rate) as avg_rate FROM daily_inspection_records WHERE inspection_date >= DATEADD(month, DATEDIFF(month,0,GETDATE()), 0) GROUP BY stage_name
+
+V├ì Dß╗ñ ΓÇö B├ÇNG GIAO:
+- "Kß║┐ hoß║ích KHSX_04_2026 ─æang b├án giao ─æ╞░ß╗úc bao nhi├¬u?" ΓåÆ
+  SELECT d.delivery_stage, d.receiving_stage, SUM(d.quantity_total) as tong_giao, SUM(d.quantity_received) as tong_nhan
+  FROM deliveries d JOIN product_plans p ON d.plan_id = p.id WHERE p.code='KHSX_04_2026' GROUP BY d.delivery_stage, d.receiving_stage
+
+Quy ─æß╗ïnh bß║úo mß║¡t v├á kß╗╣ thuß║¡t:
+- CHß╗ê chß║íy c├íc c├óu lß╗çnh SELECT ─æß╗â ─æß╗ìc dß╗» liß╗çu. Tuyß╗çt ─æß╗æi kh├┤ng thß╗¡ ghi, sß╗¡a ─æß╗òi hay x├│a dß╗» liß╗çu.

+SQL Mß║¬U ΓÇö Tß╗öNG TIß╗ÇN PHß║áT (c├│ JOIN cabinet_prices):
+SELECT 
+  SUM(CASE
+    WHEN c.action LIKE '$%' 
+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_tien_phat
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+WHERE c.period = '02-2025'   -- thay ─æß╗òi ─æiß╗üu kiß╗çn theo c├óu hß╗Åi

+SELECT
+  c.action,
+  c.product_name,
+  p.cabinet_name,
+  p.sale_price,
+  COUNT(*) as so_luong,
+  SUM(CASE
+    WHEN c.action LIKE '$%' 
+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_gia_tri
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+WHERE c.period = '02-2026'   -- thay ─æß╗òi ─æiß╗üu kiß╗çn theo c├óu hß╗Åi
+GROUP BY c.action, c.product_name, p.cabinet_name, p.sale_price
+ORDER BY tong_gia_tri DESC

+class AnthropicChatbotService:
+    """AI Chatbot service using Anthropic Claude API with database query tools."""
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.api_key = os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY")
+        self.client = None
+        self.max_retries = 2
+        self.retry_delay = 1  # seconds
+        if self.api_key:
+            try:
+                self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=self.api_key)
+            except Exception as e:
+                logger.error(f"Failed to initialize Anthropic client: {e}")
+        else:
+            logger.warning("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY not found in environment variables")
+
+    def is_available(self) -> bool:
+        """Check if Anthropic API is available."""
+        return self.client is not None or os.getenv("ANTHROPIC_API_KEY") is not None
+
+    # ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Tool Functions ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ
+
+    def get_database_schema(self) -> str:
+        """Returns the database schema for the AI to understand the structure."""
+        return DB_SCHEMA
+
+    def get_current_datetime(self) -> str:
+        """Returns the current datetime in ISO format."""
+        return datetime.now().isoformat()
+
+    def execute_read_only_query(self, query: str, db_session, captured_items: list = None) -> str:
+        """
+        Executes a read-only SQL query and returns the results as JSON.
+        Only SELECT queries are allowed for security.
+        """
+        if not query or not query.strip():
+            return json.dumps({"error": "Empty query provided."})
+
+        cleaned = query.strip()
+        
+        # Security check: only allow SELECT statements
+        if not cleaned.upper().startswith("SELECT"):
+            return json.dumps({"error": "Security violation: Query must be a SELECT statement."})
+
+        if not db_session:
+            return json.dumps({"error": "Database session is not available."})
+
+        try:
+            from sqlalchemy import text
+            print(f"\n[Anthropic_SQL] CHß║áY Lß╗åNH: {cleaned}")
+            try:
+                with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                    f.write(f"\n--- ANTHROPIC {datetime.now().isoformat()} ---\n")
+                    f.write(f"Query: {cleaned}\n")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+
+            result = db_session.execute(text(cleaned))
+
+            if result.returns_rows:
+                keys = list(result.keys())
+                rows = result.fetchall()
+                data = []
+                for row in rows:
+                    row_dict = {}
+                    for idx, col in enumerate(keys):
+                        val = row[idx]
+                        if isinstance(val, datetime):
+                            row_dict[col] = val.isoformat()
+                        else:
+                            row_dict[col] = val
+                    data.append(row_dict)
+
+                total_rows = len(data)
+                print(f"[Anthropic_SQL] Kß║╛T QUß║ó TRß║ó Vß╗Ç: {total_rows} d├▓ng")
+
+                try:
+                    with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                        f.write(f"Result count: {total_rows}\n")
+                        if total_rows > 0:
+                            f.write(f"First row: {str(data[0])}\n")
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+
+                # Capture claims data for UI card display
+                if captured_items is not None and "customer_claims" in cleaned.lower():
+                    if data and "claim_code" in data[0]:
+                        captured_items.extend(data)
+
+                return json.dumps({
+                    "success": True,
+                    "total_rows": total_rows,
+                    "data": data,
+                    "columns": keys
+                }, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
+            else:
+                try:
+                    with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                        f.write(f"Result count: 0 (No rows returned)\n")
+                except Exception:
+                    pass
+                return json.dumps({
+                    "success": True,
+                    "message": "Query executed successfully (no rows returned)",
+                    "rows_affected": result.rowcount
+                })
+
+        except Exception as e:
+            error_msg = str(e)
+            print(f"[Anthropic_SQL] Lß╗ûI: {error_msg}")
+            try:
+                with open("debug_query_log.txt", "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
+                    f.write(f"Error: {error_msg}\n")
+            except Exception:
+                pass
+            return json.dumps({"error": f"Database query error: {error_msg}"})
+
+    # ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ Chat Function ΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇΓöÇ

+    def chat_with_ai(self, message: str, db_session, context: dict = None, history: list = None) -> dict:
+        """
+        Main chat function using Anthropic Claude with tool calling.
+        """
+        if not self.client:
+            # Try to initialize client if not done
+            if self.api_key:
+                try:
+                    self.client = anthropic.Anthropic(api_key=self.api_key)
+                except Exception as e:
+                    logger.error(f"Failed to initialize Anthropic client: {e}")
+                    return {"intent": "error", "message": "Anthropic API kh├┤ng khß║ú dß╗Ñng"}
+            else:
+                return {"intent": "error", "message": "Anthropic API key kh├┤ng ─æ╞░ß╗úc cß║Ñu h├¼nh"}
+
+        captured_items = []
+        if history is None:
+            history = []
+        
+        # Prepare tools for Claude
+        tools = [
+            {
+                "name": "get_database_schema",
+                "description": "Lß║Ñy cß║Ñu tr├║c c╞í sß╗ƒ dß╗» liß╗çu ─æß╗â hiß╗âu c├íc bß║úng v├á cß╗Öt",
+                "input_schema": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {},
+                    "required": []
+                }
+            },
+            {
+                "name": "get_current_datetime",
+                "description": "Lß║Ñy ng├áy giß╗¥ hiß╗çn tß║íi",
+                "input_schema": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {},
+                    "required": []
+                }
+            },
+            {
+                "name": "execute_read_only_query",
+                "description": "Thß╗▒c thi c├óu lß╗çnh SQL SELECT ─æß╗â ─æß╗ìc dß╗» liß╗çu tß╗½ c╞í sß╗ƒ dß╗» liß╗çu",
+                "input_schema": {
+                    "type": "object",
+                    "properties": {
+                        "query": {
+                            "type": "string",
+                            "description": "C├óu lß╗çnh SQL SELECT ─æß╗â thß╗▒c thi"
+                        }
+                    },
+                    "required": ["query"]
+                }
+            }
+        ]
+
+        # Tool implementations
+        def get_database_schema_impl():
+            return self.get_database_schema()
+
+        def get_current_datetime_impl():
+            return self.get_current_datetime()
+
+        def execute_read_only_query_impl(query: str):
+            return self.execute_read_only_query(query, db_session, captured_items)
+
+        tool_map = {
+            "get_database_schema": get_database_schema_impl,
+            "get_current_datetime": get_current_datetime_impl,
+            "execute_read_only_query": execute_read_only_query_impl
+        }
+
+        # Build messages from history
+        messages = []
+        for turn in history:
+            role = turn.get("role", "user")
+            content = turn.get("content", "")
+            if role in ("user", "assistant") and content:
+                messages.append({"role": role, "content": content})
+
+        # Inject context filters
+        context_str = ""
+        if context:
+            parts = []
+            for k, v in context.items():
+                if v is not None and not k.startswith("last_items") and not k.startswith("last_intent"):
+                    parts.append(f"- {k}: {v}")
+            if parts:
+                context_str = "\n\nNgß╗» cß║únh hiß╗çn tß║íi:\n" + "\n".join(parts)
+
+        user_content = f"C├óu hß╗Åi cß╗ºa ng╞░ß╗¥i d├╣ng: {message}"
+        if context_str:
+            user_content = f"[{context_str.strip()}]\n\n{user_content}"
+
+        messages.append({
+            "role": "user",
+            "content": user_content
+        })
+
+        try:
+            # Use Claude 3.5 Haiku (free tier, faster, good for tool use)
+            response = self.client.messages.create(
+                model="claude-3-5-haiku-20241022",
+                max_tokens=4096,
+                system=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
+                messages=messages,
+                tools=tools,
+                tool_choice={"type": "auto"}
+            )
+
+            # Process tool calls if any
+            tool_use_results = []
+            for block in response.content:
+                if block.type == "tool_use":
+                    tool_name = block.name
+                    tool_input = block.input
+                    tool_id = block.id
+
+                    # Execute the tool
+                    if tool_name in tool_map:
+                        try:
+                            if tool_name == "execute_read_only_query":
+                                result = tool_map[tool_name](tool_input["query"])
+                            else:
+                                result = tool_map[tool_name]()
+                            
+                            tool_use_results.append({
+                                "tool_use_id": tool_id,
+                                "result": result
+                            })
+                        except Exception as e:
+                            tool_use_results.append({
+                                "tool_use_id": tool_id,
+                                "result": json.dumps({"error": str(e)})
+                            })
+
+            # If there were tool calls, send results back to Claude
+            if tool_use_results:
+                # Add assistant response with tool calls
+                messages.append({
+                    "role": "assistant",
+                    "content": response.content
+                })
+
+                # Add tool results
+                for tool_result in tool_use_results:
+                    messages.append({
+                        "role": "user",
+                        "content": [
+                            {
+                                "type": "tool_result",
+                                "tool_use_id": tool_result["tool_use_id"],
+                                "content": tool_result["result"]
+                            }
+                        ]
+                    })
+
+                # Get final response
+                final_response = self.client.messages.create(
+                    model="claude-3-5-haiku-20241022",
+                    max_tokens=4096,
+                    system=SYSTEM_PROMPT,
+                    messages=messages
+                )
+
+                # Extract final text response
+                final_text = ""
+                for block in final_response.content:
+                    if block.type == "text":
+                        final_text = block.text
+                        break
+
+                return {
+                    "intent": "ai_response",
+                    "message": final_text,
+                    "items": captured_items,
+                    "source": "anthropic_claude"
+                }
+            else:
+                # No tool calls, just return the text response
+                text_response = ""
+                for block in response.content:
+                    if block.type == "text":
+                        text_response = block.text
+                        break
+
+                return {
+                    "intent": "ai_response",
+                    "message": text_response,
+                    "items": captured_items,
+                    "source": "anthropic_claude"
+                }
+
+        except anthropic.RateLimitError as e:
+            from modules.chatbot.services.error_helper import clean_error_message
+            cleaned_err = clean_error_message(e)
+            logger.error(f"Lß╗ùi giß╗¢i hß║ín l╞░ß╗út Anthropic: \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m")
+            return {"intent": "error", "message": cleaned_err}
+        except anthropic.APIError as e:
+            from modules.chatbot.services.error_helper import clean_error_message
+            cleaned_err = clean_error_message(e)
+            logger.error(f"Lß╗ùi Anthropic: \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m")
+            return {"intent": "error", "message": cleaned_err}
+        except Exception as e:
+            from modules.chatbot.services.error_helper import clean_error_message
+            cleaned_err = clean_error_message(e)
+            logger.error(f"Lß╗ùi hß╗ç thß╗æng Anthropic: \033[91m{cleaned_err}\033[0m")
+            return {"intent": "error", "message": cleaned_err}
+

+anthropic_chatbot_service = AnthropicChatbotService()

+# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
+import re
+
+def extract_filters(message: str) -> dict:
+    """
+    Extracts query filters (month, year, sku, defect code, action, LPN, container, cabinet) from raw message.
+    Supports Vietnamese formats like "th├íng 2", "thang 2", "T2", etc.
+    """
+    filters = {}
+    msg = message.lower()
+    
+    # Extract period / month / year
+    # Examples: "th├íng 02-2026", "th├íng 2/2026", "th├íng 2 n─âm 2026", "02-2026", "2026"
+    period_match = re.search(r'(?:th├íng|thang)\s*(\d{1,2})\s*(?:-|/|n─âm|nam)?\s*(\d{4})', msg)
+    if period_match:
+        m = period_match.group(1).zfill(2)
+        y = period_match.group(2)
+        filters["period"] = f"{m}-{y}"
+    else:
+        # Check standalone date format like MM-YYYY or MM/YYYY
+        simple_date = re.search(r'\b(\d{1,2})[-/](\d{4})\b', msg)
+        if simple_date:
+            m = simple_date.group(1).zfill(2)
+            y = simple_date.group(2)
+            filters["period"] = f"{m}-{y}"
+        else:
+            # Standalone month: "th├íng 2", "thang 2", "T2", "t2"
+            month_match = re.search(r'(?:th├íng|thang)\s*(\d{1,2})\b', msg)
+            t_match = re.search(r'\bt(\d{1,2})\b', msg)
+            if month_match:
+                filters["month"] = month_match.group(1).zfill(2)
+            elif t_match:
+                filters["month"] = t_match.group(1).zfill(2)
+                
+            # Standalone year: "n─âm 2026", "nam 2026"
+            year_match = re.search(r'(?:n─âm|nam)\s*(\d{4})\b', msg)
+            if year_match:
+                filters["year"] = year_match.group(1)
+            else:
+                # Standalone year four digits if not part of date and not month
+                if not month_match and not t_match:
+                    four_digit = re.search(r'\b(202\d)\b', msg)
+                    if four_digit:
+                        filters["year"] = four_digit.group(1)
+                        
+    # Extract Limit/Count - More flexible patterns
+    # Patterns: "cho t├┤i 1 c├íi", "lß║Ñy 2 bß║ún ghi", "xem 3 d├▓ng", "1 khiß║┐u nß║íi", "5 claim", "phiß║┐u 1 c├íi"
+    limit_keywords = ["c├íi", "bß║ún ghi", "d├▓ng", "khiß║┐u nß║íi", "claim", "phiß║┐u", "l├┤", "kß║┐t quß║ú", "bß║ún"]
+    
+    # Try pattern: "cho t├┤i X c├íi", "lß║Ñy X bß║ún ghi", etc.
+    for kw in limit_keywords:
+        pattern = rf'\b(\d+)\s+{kw}'
+        match = re.search(pattern, msg)
+        if match:
+            filters["limit"] = int(match.group(1))
+            break
+    
+    # If not found, try pattern: "c├íi X", "bß║ún ghi X" (less common but possible)
+    if "limit" not in filters:
+        for kw in limit_keywords:
+            pattern = rf'{kw}\s*(\d+)'
+            match = re.search(pattern, msg)
+            if match:
+                filters["limit"] = int(match.group(1))
+                break
+    
+    # If still not found, try standalone number with context words
+    if "limit" not in filters:
+        context_words = ["cho", "lß║Ñy", "xem", "hiß╗çn", "liß╗çt k├¬", "liet ke", "t├¼m", "tim"]
+        if any(cw in msg for cw in context_words):
+            # Find first number in the message
+            numbers = re.findall(r'\b(\d+)\b', msg)
+            if numbers:
+                filters["limit"] = int(numbers[0])
+        
+    # Extract cabinet number - enhanced patterns
+    cab_match = re.search(r'(?:cabinet|tß╗º|tu)\s*#?\s*(\d+)', msg)
+    if cab_match:
+        filters["cabinet_no"] = int(cab_match.group(1))
+    else:
+        sharp_match = re.search(r'#(\d+)', msg)
+        if sharp_match:
+            filters["cabinet_no"] = int(sharp_match.group(1))
+        else:
+            # Pattern: "tß╗º 5", "cabinet 5", "tu 5"
+            simple_cab = re.search(r'(?:tß╗º|tu|cabinet)\s*(\d+)', msg)
+            if simple_cab:
+                filters["cabinet_no"] = int(simple_cab.group(1))
+            
+    # Extract defect code - enhanced patterns
+    defect_match = re.search(r'\b([a-z]{2,4}[-_]?[0-9]+[a-z0-9_-]*)\b', msg)
+    if defect_match:
+        val = defect_match.group(1).upper()
+        if not re.match(r'^[A-Z]{4}[0-9]{7}$', val):
+            filters["defect_code"] = val
+    else:
+        # Pattern: "lß╗ùi DVA_17", "ma loi APP-24"
+        defect_follow = re.search(r'(?:lß╗ùi|loi|m├ú lß╗ùi|ma loi|defect)\s*[:\s]*([a-z0-9_-]+)', msg)
+        if defect_follow:
+            val = defect_follow.group(1).upper()
+            ignore_defect_words = {
+                "Bß╗è", "BI", "PHß║áT", "PHAT", "Nß║╢NG", "NANG", "NHß║╕", "NHE", 
+                "NHIß╗ÇU", "NHIEU", "Lß╗ÜN", "LON", "NHß╗Ä", "NHO", "Hß║╛T", "HET", 
+                "Cß╗ªA", "CUA", "CHO", "Vß╗ÜI", "VOI", "─É├â", "DA", "CH╞»A", "CHUA", 
+                "─ÉANG", "DANG", "TRONG", "PH├üT", "SINH", "G├î", "GI"
+            }
+            if val not in ignore_defect_words and len(val) >= 3:
+                filters["defect_code"] = val
+        
+    # Extract Action
+    if any(k in msg for k in ["full bc", "full bß╗Ö", "full bo", "phß║ít full", "phat full"]):
+        filters["action"] = "Full BC"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["$50", "50 ─æ├┤", "50 do", "50$"]):
+        filters["action"] = "$50"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["repair", "sß╗¡a chß╗»a", "sua chua"]):
+        filters["action"] = "Repair"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["x2 unit", "x2"]):
+        filters["action"] = "X2 Unit"
+        
+    # Extract Container
+    cont_match = re.search(r'\b([a-z]{4}[0-9]{7})\b', msg)
+    if cont_match:
+        filters["container_no"] = cont_match.group(1).upper()
+        
+    # Extract LPN
+    lpn_match = re.search(r'\b(\d{7,10})\b', msg)
+    if lpn_match:
+        filters["lpn"] = lpn_match.group(1)
+        
+    # Extract SKU
+    sku_match = re.search(r'\b([a-z0-9]{3,5}-[a-z0-9-]+)\b', msg)
+    if sku_match:
+        filters["sku"] = sku_match.group(1).upper()
+    else:
+        sku_follow = re.search(r'\b(?:sku|sß║ún phß║⌐m|san pham|m├ú h├áng|ma hang)\s+([a-z0-9-]+)\b', msg)
+        if sku_follow:
+            filters["sku"] = sku_follow.group(1).upper()
+        
+    # Extract Status (Received/Processing/Resolved -> Mß╗¢i/─Éang xß╗¡ l├╜/─É├ú xß╗¡ l├╜)
+    if any(k in msg for k in ["ch╞░a xß╗¡ l├╜", "chua xu ly", "mß╗¢i", "moi nhß║¡n", "ch╞░a giß║úi quyß║┐t"]):
+        filters["status"] = "Mß╗¢i"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["─æang xß╗¡ l├╜", "dang xu ly", "─æang giß║úi quyß║┐t", "dang giai quyet"]):
+        filters["status"] = "─Éang xß╗¡ l├╜"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["─æ├ú xß╗¡ l├╜", "da xu ly", "ho├án th├ánh", "hoan thanh", "─æ├ú giß║úi quyß║┐t", "da giai quyet", "resolved"]):
+        filters["status"] = "─É├ú xß╗¡ l├╜"
+        
+    # Extract Severity
+    if any(k in msg for k in ["phß║ít nß║╖ng", "phat nang", "nghi├¬m trß╗ìng", "nghiem trong", "nguy hiß╗âm", "cao", "high"]):
+        filters["severity"] = "High"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["trung b├¼nh", "medium", "vß╗½a", "tß║ím"]):
+        filters["severity"] = "Medium"
+    elif any(k in msg for k in ["phß║ít nhß║╣", "phat nhe", "thß║Ñp", "low", "nhß║╣"]):
+        filters["severity"] = "Low"
+        
+    # Standard keyword extraction for general searches
+    # Skip if we already have specific filters (year, month, period, etc.)
+    has_specific_filter = any(k in filters for k in ["year", "month", "period", "cabinet_no", "sku", "defect_code", "container_no", "lpn", "action", "status", "severity"])
+    
+    if not has_specific_filter:
+        clean_msg = re.sub(r'[?.,!\(\)]', ' ', msg)
+        words = clean_msg.split()
+        ignore_words = {
+            "t├¼m", "claim", "khiß║┐u", "nß║íi", "cß╗ºa", "cho", "c├│", "bß╗ï", "lß╗ùi", "m├ú", "th├íng", "n─âm", "tß╗º", "cabinet", "n├áo", "ß╗ƒ", "trong",
+            "xuß║Ñt", "hiß╗çn", "nhiß╗üu", "nhß║Ñt", "g├¼", "bao", "nhi├¬u", "thß╗æng", "k├¬", "xem", "liß╗çt", "─æ├óu", "sao", "thß║┐", "kh├┤ng", "tß╗òng",
+            "hß║┐t", "to├án", "bß╗Ö", "danh", "s├ích", "phß╗ò", "biß║┐n", "top", "mß║Ñy", "tß║Ñt", "cß║ú", "hay", "nh╞░", "th├¼", "vß╗¢i", "─æ╞░ß╗úc", "hß╗Åi",
+            "biß║┐t", "gi├║p", "kiß╗âm", "tra", "container", "cont", "lpn", "sku", "trß║íng", "th├íi", "mß╗⌐c", "─æß╗Ö"
+        }
+        keywords = [w for w in words if w not in ignore_words and len(w) > 2]
+        if keywords:
+            filters["keyword"] = " ".join(keywords)
+        
+    return filters

+SQL Mß║¬U ΓÇö Tß╗öNG TIß╗ÇN PHß║áT (c├│ JOIN cabinet_prices):
+SELECT 
+  SUM(CASE
+    WHEN c.action LIKE '$%' 
+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_tien_phat
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+WHERE c.period = '02-2025'   -- thay ─æß╗òi ─æiß╗üu kiß╗çn theo c├óu hß╗Åi

+SQL Mß║¬U ΓÇö CHI TIß║╛T Tß╗¬NG D├ÆNG PHß║áT (Bß║«T BUß╗ÿC d├╣ng khi y├¬u cß║ºu chi tiß║┐t hoß║╖c list ra tß╗½ng c├íi):
+SELECT
+  c.action,
+  c.product_name,
+  p.cabinet_name,
+  p.sale_price,
+  COUNT(*) as so_luong,
+  SUM(CASE
+    WHEN c.action LIKE '$%' 
+      THEN TRY_CAST(REPLACE(REPLACE(c.action, '$', ''), ' ', '') AS FLOAT)
+    WHEN c.action = 'Full BC' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price, 0)
+    WHEN c.action = 'X2 Unit' 
+      THEN COALESCE(p.sale_price * 2, 0)
+    ELSE 0
+  END) AS tong_gia_tri
+FROM customer_claims c
+LEFT JOIN cabinet_prices p ON (c.product_name = p.cabinet_name OR c.product_name = p.cabinet_code)
+WHERE c.period = '02-2026'   -- thay ─æß╗òi ─æiß╗üu kiß╗çn theo c├óu hß╗Åi
+GROUP BY c.action, c.product_name, p.cabinet_name, p.sale_price
+ORDER BY tong_gia_tri DESC
